title: Concept: Keychain item readable while the device is locked in swift — review required
description: In swift, a keychain item is marked accessible regardless of lock state. The accessibility class is the only thing that binds a secret to device unlock, and choosing Always removes that binding. The constant is also deprecated, which makes its presence a signal of copied legacy code.
applicability: swift iOS applications that store credentials.
risk: Credential disclosure while the device is locked; MEDIUM severity.
